subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The same adult male host is consistently shown with similar hair, beard, build, and the dark blue shirt with bright green logo, though facial rendering shifts slightly across cuts.

background_coherent.rationale: The beige living room, balcony doors, bright outdoor greenery, wall art, blue armchair, and doorway layout remain broadly consistent, with some spatial ambiguity around the doorway versus balcony-door area.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches the medium host view near the doorway with balcony daylight and invariant shirt; the seating-area gesture is not very explicit.
Wider view with the blue armchair and room layout visible; the host appears to gesture across the room.
Balcony doors and bright exterior are visible, but the host is still mostly facing the camera and the outside-pointing action is weak.
Closer side-ish doorway angle and bright light fit partially, but the door-opening action and exact balcony-door placement are unclear.
The host is near a doorway, but the requested look back toward chair, table, and wall art is only partially supported because those room features are mostly off-frame.
Medium shot beside the door with the invariant shirt; lowering hands or nodding cannot be strongly confirmed from a single frame.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence varies framing, host position, camera angle, and visible room elements without collapsing into copied shots.

motion_continuity.rationale: The host plausibly moves through the living room and toward the door area, with changing arm positions and camera viewpoints across shots.

which_cut_broke.how: No single transition clearly breaks identity or scene continuity; the main weakness is gradual caption/action ambiguity around shots 3 and 4.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are not duplicated or frozen, and they preserve meaningful camera and scene variation.
